newsitem.title: PAKISTAN: Pakistan raises crop prices to boost agriculture.
newsitem.headline: Pakistan raises crop prices to boost agriculture.

text.p: Pakistan's Prime Minister Nawaz Sharif raised support prices of crops including wheat, rice and sunflower in an agriculture package announced on Thursday.
He told a farmers' convention that the government was raising the support price of wheat to 240 rupees per 40 kg from 185 rupees and sunflower price to 450 rupees per 40 kg from 385 rupees.
Sharif said prices of IRRI rice would be raised by 25 rupees per 40 kg and of rapeseed to 450 rupees per 40 kg from 400 rupees.
He said these incentives were being given to help increase food production.
"I am sure that this package, with your support, will make Pakistan prosperous and self-sufficient in food," Sharif said. --Islamabad newsroom 9251-274757
